title: Water and Bread
label: ch:hi-water-and-bread
canDo: I can ask for water and bread in Hindi and say what पानी literally means.

payoff.summary: Ask for पानी and रोटी, then unpack पानी as 'the drinkable one' — pā, to drink, plus -nīya, fit for.
payoff.note: HI-C15-paani-roti now also recalls ढोल, 'a drum', from HI-C15-dhol (sequence 619): 3 of the chapter's 5 atoms. The two one-character recognition segments (HI-S119-letter-ssa, HI-S137-letter-dha-retroflex, sequence 621-622) come after the payoff in reading order, so it cannot honestly assess them.
